eyebrow: Microsoft Fabric & Real-Time Analytics · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 24 · Real-Time Data Engineering

code:
RawTripEvents
| summarize TripCount = count(), AvgFare = avg(fare_amount) by VendorID
caption: by VendorID = GROUP BY. name = expression, computed per group.

code:
| summarize
    TripCount = count(),
    TotalRevenue = sum(fare_amount),
    AvgFare = avg(fare_amount),
    MaxDistance = max(trip_distance)
    by VendorID
caption: The exact same functions from Foundations' pyspark.sql.functions -- KQL's own syntax.

eyebrow: bin() — grouping by a time window
code:
RawTripEvents
| summarize TripCount = count() by bin(pickup_time, 1h)

# Rounds pickup_time DOWN to the start of its hour.
caption: A genuinely new idea -- real time-bucket grouping, no Foundations equivalent.
